newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Aug inflation seen below 8.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Aug inflation seen below 8.0 pct.

text.p: Philippine planning minister Cielito Habito said on Wednesday that the August inflation rate is likely to be below 8.0 percent.
The government's National Statistics Office is due to release the figures on Thursday morning.
"We expect this to be even less than 8.0 percent," Habito, also head of the National Economic Development Authority, told reporters.
Philippine inflation spiked to around 12 percent late last year because of a rice shortage but has been coming down steadily since then. The July figure was 8.9 percent year on year.
Habito said he did not expect any major adverse impact from rising oil prices as a result of two U.S. missile attacks against Iraq.
"Our economy has become resilient enough to weather such problems coming from outside," he said.
